description.value:
Tear ducts re-plumbed with glands lifted from something that hunted by weeping first. Once per hour, 1 action: a target within 5 feet that meets your gaze must succeed at a Will save vs your class DC or be fascinated 1 round.

Donor: It still wants to look at things a certain way. At Resonance 6+ the GM may have your gaze linger somewhere it shouldn't.

cinderfall.incomplete: The whole ability is a limited-use (once/hour) activated gaze attack with its own save and condition -- needs a granted Action item, same class of gap as every other once-per-timeframe activated ability in this pass.
